name: Ambi Fitness Club

reviews.author: Soni Parveen
reviews.text: Ambi is hands-down the most amazing gym trainer! From day one, she has welcomed everyone with an infectious smile and genuine warmth. She has a rare ability to treat her clients like family, creating a supportive environment where everyone feels valued. If you want a trainer who truly cares about your well-being and keeps you motivated, Ambi is the absolute best. Her energy is unmatched! No matter how tough the day is, she always meet us with a bright smile. Thank you for treating us like family and creating such a warm, welcoming community at the gym. You don't just train our bodies; you lift our spirits too!

reviews.author: Naseeba
reviews.text:
I used to feel that the gym wasn’t my thing at all. I lacked confidence and always stayed away, even though I admired the results others were getting. But joining Ambi Fitness Club completely changed my perspective.

The environment here is incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made it so much easier for a beginner like me to get started. I especially appreciate the private workout space for ladies—it adds a great level of comfort and confidence.

A big thank you to the amazing coaches—Sharath, Ziyan, and Saji 🫡 Their constant motivation, support, and guidance make every session a positive experience.

If you’re someone who feels unsure or intimidated about joining a gym, this is the perfect place to begin. Highly recommended! 🙌🏻

reviews.author: mintu antony
reviews.text:
I had a very good experience at Ambi Gym & Fitness. When I started my training, I was 109 kg, and with personal training, regular workouts, and the diet plan provided by Ambika Madam, I was able to reduce 5 kg in just one month.The training was very effective, and the trainers were extremely supportive, motivating, and attentive throughout my fitness journey. The combination of proper diet guidance and structured training really helped me stay consistent and achieve visible results.

A special thanks to Ambika Madam, Akhil, Sunil, and all the other trainers at the fitness center for their continuous support and encouragement. I truly appreciate the effort and guidance from the entire team.

Highly recommended for anyone who is serious about improving their fitness and losing weight! 💪

reviews.author: Aarathi R Krishna
reviews.text:
My experience with Ambi Fitness club has been truly positive and rewarding. Since starting my fitness journey, I have noticed a significant difference in my overall health and well-being. I have achieved weight loss as well as noticeable inch loss, which has been extremely motivating.
One of the biggest changes I have noticed is in my energy levels and daily routine. Earlier, I found it difficult to wake up in the morning, but now I can wake up with ease and feel much more energetic and refreshed.
A special mention to Ms. Ambika Suneesh for her constant guidance, motivation and encouragement throughout my journey. I also really appreciate the trainers for their support, patience and dedication. Their guidance has helped me stay consistent and enjoy the process.
The combination of regular workouts, better eating habits, professional guidance and consistency has made a real difference. I am very happy with the progress I have made so far and grateful to the entire Ambi Fitness team for being such an important part of my fitness journey. I feel healthier, more active, energetic and confident than before

reviews.author: Vivek Clal
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Best Fitness Club in Al Qusais – Ambi Fitness Club

Ambi Fitness Club in Al Qusais, Dubai, is more than just a gym – it’s a complete transformation hub under the expert guidance of Coach Ambi, a highly professional fitness trainer and martial arts expert. Her dedication, knowledge, and passion for fitness make every workout session motivating and result-driven.

The club is well-equipped with modern machines, a clean and spacious environment, and a positive atmosphere that inspires consistency. What truly makes it stand out is the personal attention given by Coach Ambi and his team of skilled sub-trainers. Whether you’re a beginner, a fitness enthusiast, or someone looking to learn martial arts, you’ll find customized training plans tailored to your goals.

Coach Ambi’s expertise in martial arts adds a unique edge – improving not just strength and stamina, but also discipline, self-defense, and mental focus. Her supportive approach ensures that every member feels encouraged, confident, and capable of pushing their limits safely.

If you’re looking for the perfect balance of fitness, martial arts training, and professional guidance, Ambi Fitness Club is the best choice in Dubai. Highly recommended for anyone serious about health, fitness, and personal growth!

reviews.text: I’ve been a member of this gym for some time now, and I must say, it’s not about the flashy equipment but the dedication of the trainers that makes it stand out. Despite having fewer equipment options, the trainers here really know how to make the most out of what’s available. They provide personalized workouts, offer constant motivation, and create a supportive atmosphere that keeps us all motivated to shed those extra pounds. It’s not just a gym; it’s a place where real effort and commitment shine through. Highly recommended!”👍
